newsitem.title: CHINA: China Dec interest rate subsidy 3.72 pct - paper.
newsitem.headline: China Dec interest rate subsidy 3.72 pct - paper.

text.p: China's central People's Bank of China has set the interest rate subsidy on deposits of three years or more at 3.72 percent, the China Securities newspaper said on Monday.
The subsidy compared with 4.04 percent in November, 3.62 percent in October and 3.61 percent in September.
China said in March it would stop paying interest rate subsidies on new deposits of three years and above from April 1 as inflation eased.
Falling inflation would enable China to stop paying the subsidy by end-1996 or early next year, state media has said.
Such subsidies would continue to be paid on fixed deposits made before April 1.
Retail price inflation was a year-on-year 4.7 percent in October and 6.4 percent in the first 10 months of this year.
